body:
The Design page's Preview button and its Show/Hide changes button don't look like the buttons on the rest of the app.

- **Preview / Exit preview:** today a dark filled button. It takes the app's ordinary button look (the shared control styles the task detail and Settings use).
- **Show/Hide changes:** today a 🔍 icon whose words are only a tooltip. Leave the icon as is.

Out of scope: the other Design page buttons (Restore, Proposed / Current).

**Tests:** both buttons use the shared button look
title: design: buttons match the app
